_comment: #508. Mediterranean revival built in one go on the 1915 Exposition fill, so it is the palest and
the most uniform palette in the library: white-cream stucco, warm ivory, a barely-there sage and
a bone grey. The draws sit very close together on purpose - a Marina block IS uniform, and that
sameness is the district's read, not a bug of the kind #508 was filed about (compare Mission,
where the draws are deliberately far apart).
What separates it from West of Twin Peaks, the other pale stucco district, is that Accent1 goes
brighter than the wall (a chalk white sash against cream) and the terracotta in the Accent2 ramp
is pinker and lighter - Marina tile is newer and sun-bleached where the residence-park tile is
